ideas.pitch: Real-time AR cognitive load and attention monitor using iOS Vision framework to help knowledge workers prevent burnout during deep work sprints.
ideas.title: MindScope AR Focus Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the successful live-demo mechanics of BaseScanning by combining native device sensors with real-time AR feedback, presenting a polished and immediately testable iOS experience.

ideas.pitch: A local-first graph intelligence tool that aggregates fragmented notes, links, and code snippets into an interactive knowledge web for rapid ideation.
ideas.title: IdeaMesh Graph Brain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph-based data architectures similar to Bito, appealing to judges looking for structured data visualization over generic text generators.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined, serverless algorithmic trading strategy validator utilizing probabilistic forecasting and historical market data feeds.
ideas.title: QuantumFlow Algorithmic Backtester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning blueprint of ClashX and AI-incident forecasting by offering quantitative rigor, clear visual backtests, and statistical validity.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered daily routine and micro-habit synthesizer that adapts to personal productivity rhythms and cognitive fatigue metrics.
ideas.title: NeuroPace Habit Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the rapid-value delivery and personalization engine seen in E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant, focusing on an intuitive consumer-grade workflow.

ideas.pitch: Automated geospatial change detection pipeline using open-source satellite imagery to track urban green space modifications over time.
ideas.title: EcoInsight Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs heavy technical execution in computer vision and satellite data parsing, echoing the technical depth of GeoNex-ATLAS.
